items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Joe said, “man, that was killing.” So John said, “well can you do the chart?”

ctx.x: But it was funny. And it did sound really terrific. You’d play that and you would have no idea it was like emulated saxophone sounds or brass sounds. Except for the live trumpet and live rhythm. But Joe said, “man, that was killing.” So John said, “well can you do the chart?” “Yeah the chart’s all there, you just have to write it out for the live horns, man, and you’ve got it.
